checks: Fresh installation: every runtime file matches the prepackaged payload

A real locked app.asar stops replacement, names the file, restores all original runtime bytes, and preserves credentials
Reinstall succeeds after the lock is released, without nested installation paths
Setup launched inside the installation directory hands off and finishes the full upgrade
Real uninstall removes application and credentials while retaining external papers and notes
installerLifecycle.scope: Full electron-builder NSIS install/upgrade/rollback/uninstall transactions with the supplied runtime, isolated identity and disabled shortcuts/launch
limitations: Native interactive wizard appearance is not automated

checks: Setup inside the application directory does not detect itself
Unrelated executable in the exact installation directory is ignored
Same executable name in a prefix-sharing sibling directory is ignored
Another independent installation is ignored
Exact target process is identified by PID, including Unicode, spaces, quotes and dollar signs
Silent install fails boundedly when the app is running and never force-kills it or unrelated processes
Closing the target clears the check while unrelated processes remain alive
Uninstaller uses the same native exact-path guard
Setup below the legacy install prefix relaunches from isolated cache, waits for its parent and preserves /S and /D
The legacy directory-prefix predicate is clear after handoff

limitations: No live-model quality or cost validation for the planning reset
